items.label: America's #1 TV Streaming Platform, All Top Apps
items.value: With Roku as your entertainment guide, exploring popular apps like NetfIix, Prime Video, Hulu, YouTube, Roku Channel—plus free movies, shows, and live TV—is as easy as it is fun. No dongles or extra remotes. Enjoy 500+ TV channels with live news and weather, sports coverage, and more—totally free.

items.label: A Simple and Fast Home Screen
items.value: Enjoy a simple projector interface with intuitive navigation, quick search, and personalized recommendations. No-nonsense remote keep it effortless, while the Roku mobile app lets you control with your phone, type easily, or use voice commands.

items.label: 1080P Full HD Resolution
items.value: Enjoy your favorite movies and TV shows in stunning high-definition picture quality for enhanced clarity and detail. This projector is perfect for creating a massive 60 to 150-inch screen for your home theater and outdoor movie nights.

items.label: 3 Levels Brightness for All Your Spaces
items.value: Low (LOW POWER) for dim basements, medium (STANDARD) for cozy bedrooms, high (VIVID) for living rooms or outdoor nights (cuts through extra light for sharp visuals).

items.label: Auto Focus & Keystone Zero-Fuss
items.value: Advanced auto focus and auto keystone correction instantly adjust for a sharp, aligned screen-just place, power on, and enjoy a big screen without manual setup.

items.label: DoIby Audio and Dual 5W Speakers
items.value: Enjoy deep, resonant audio and precise sound details that make you feel like you're part of the action with DoIby Audio and 3D stereo sound. The built-in Dual 5W speakers deliver crisp, powerful sound that fills the room.

items.label: WiFi & Bluetooth 5.2
items.value: Connect via Bluetooth 5.2 to headphones or speakers for a private or cinematic experience. Dual-band WiFi (2.4G/5G) ensures smooth, lag-free streaming.

items.label: A Perfect Fit for Any Smart Homes
items.value: Enjoy easy voice control over your smart projector, which is compatible with Apple HomeKit, Siri, Alexa, and Google Assistant—enabling broader device compatibility and smarter voice control, so your entertainment stays effortless and connected.

items.label: Perfectly compatible with Apple TV
items.value: Supports AirPlay mirroring, built-in Apple TV, Apple-Smart Home integration; In addition, also works seamlessly with all Android devices for smooth streaming.
